def test_short_page_with_cursor_keeps_paging_for_any_account():
    feed = ScriptedFeed({
        (None, 2): Page((item("A"), item("B")), "c1"),
        ("c1", 2): Page((item("C"),), "c2"),
        ("c2", 2): Page((item("D"), item("Q", "quarantine")), None),
    })
    rows = InventoryClient(feed).list_available("treasury")
    assert [row.sku for row in rows] == ["A", "B", "C", "D"]
    assert feed.calls == [
        ("treasury", None, 2),
        ("treasury", "c1", 2),
        ("treasury", "c2", 2),
    ]
EOF
